$comment: Structural defects the DOM audit sees and we have decided to live with — the "Known and deliberate" list of docs/design-review.md, machine-readable. Regenerate with `npm run visual:check -- --update`, then write the "why" for every new row before committing it: a row with a TODO why is a row nobody has justified. `el` may be "*" to allow a kind anywhere. See ADR 0011.

allow.why: The phone's bottom sheet clips its own peek when collapsed — that is what a collapsed sheet is. Also the sheet specimen in the gallery, which is the same component in a contained frame.
The collapsed sheet's body, clipped by the sheet above it.
gallery.html at phone width: the clock table specimen, whose figures are `nowrap` by design (docs/design-review.md, finding 6), inside the stage's scroll rail.
The clock table specimen's head, carried past the edge by the table.
The clock table specimen's body, carried past the edge by the table.
A row of the clock table specimen, carried past the edge by the table.
A header cell of the clock table specimen, carried past the edge by the table.
A cell of the clock table specimen, carried past the edge by the table.

A person's or place's name inside a sentence of the narrative, and the title of a work inside a citation — WCAG 2.5.8's own "in a sentence" exception, because a 24px box around either is 24px of leading in the middle of a paragraph. Every name is also a Related chip under the beat, and every work is also an entry in the bibliography card, both at full size (docs/accessibility.md).

Two classless anchors, both inline in a run of prose: the footnote reference superscript, whose equivalent is the numbered Sources list under the card, and the basemap attribution links MapLibre writes into its own credit line. Same exception as a.entity-link (docs/accessibility.md).
